basic_details.job_title: BRIC-THSTI Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online for 10 Scientist Posts
basic_details.short_information: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (BRIC-THSTI), an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council under the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science and Technology, has invited online applications for 10 regular scientist positions: Scientist-H (1), Scientist-G (1), Scientist-F (2) and Scientist-E (6). The posts carry Pay Level 15 to 13, with monthly emoluments of ₹2,71,542 to ₹3,99,092 at present rates. how_to_apply: Apply online at the Institute's website https://thsti.res.in/en/Jobs. Applications through any other mode are not accepted.

Indicate the chosen mode, Direct Recruitment or Deputation/Absorption, on the recruitment portal. Applicants eligible under both modes who want to be considered under both must submit a separate application for each mode.
Complete the three steps: Step 1 Details of applicant, Step 2 Uploading of documents, Step 3 Payment of application fee.
Pay the fee by Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking or UPI. No corrections or modifications are possible once payment is made.
After successful submission, an auto-generated email with the reference number is sent to the email address provided. Note this number for future correspondence.
Print a copy of the online application form using the print button on the dashboard.

Deputation/Absorption applicants must send the printout with all supporting documents, through the proper channel, in a sealed envelope by Speed Post to: Head-Administration, BRIC-THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad-121001 (Haryana), India. The last date for the hard copy is 25 January 2027.
Write the application form number, advertisement number and the name of the post applied for on the sealed envelope.
For technical queries only, send an email to [email protected] with a screenshot of the error displayed, if any.
All documents except the passport-size photo and signature must be in PDF format.

Original concept note of no more than two pages, summarising relevant past work and proposed contribution at BRIC-THSTI. It must reflect the applicant's own ideas; generative AI tools, if used, should be limited to language editing.
Soft copy of passport-size photo and signature (jpeg/jpg/png).
Comprehensive CV with qualifications, positions held and professional experience/distinctions.
Matriculation (10th) and Intermediate (12th) certificates/mark sheets.
Graduation and Post-Graduation degree certificates/mark sheets.
PhD degree certificate (if applicable).
Relevant experience certificates.
Forwarding letter/NOC from the current employer, for candidates working in Government/PSUs/autonomous bodies.
Caste/Disability certificate in the recent format prescribed by the Government of India.

For deputation/absorption hard copy: Employer Certificate as per Annexure-1 and APARs for the preceding five years, plus Annual Work Reports for the preceding five years where the employer maintains them.
important_instructions: Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Autonomous bodies must forward applications through proper channel with an NOC certifying that no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated and that they are clear from the vigilance angle. The Employer Certificate (Annexure-1) states, among other points, that the cadre controlling authority has no objection and that the applicant will be relieved within a period of 3 months. A document in a language other than Hindi or English needs an English transcript attested by a Gazetted officer or a notary, to be uploaded. No enquiry seeking advice on eligibility will be entertained; candidates must check that they meet the essential qualifications and experience. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. If a candidate is found not to meet the criteria during recruitment, the candidature is cancelled; if found after appointment, the candidate is terminated in accordance with due process. Canvassing or providing false information in any form is a disqualification. The position is filled based on the Institute's requirement and the availability of a suitable candidate. The notice states that women candidates are encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: BRIC-THSTI works with academic and industry partners to turn biomedical discoveries into public-health innovations. Its campus is at the NCR Biotech Science Cluster, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad. The notice names its Medical Research Centre (MRC), which supports advanced clinical research, and the APEX Centre, an integrated pre-product-development facility that is being operationalised.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 10 posts in total. Scientist-E is the only post with reserved vacancies. The notice says none of the posts is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), but they are identified as suitable for locomotor disability (OA, OL, OAL including leprosy cured, dwarfism and acid attack victims), hard of hearing, low vision, and multiple disabilities from among these categories (excluding deaf-blindness). UR means Unreserved, OBC means Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy layer) and SC means Scheduled Caste. The monthly emoluments are at present rates of initial Basic Pay + DA + HRA + TA + Employer's NPS.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The closing date of the online application is the crucial date for determining eligibility for age, essential qualifications and experience. The experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification for the post. All qualifications must be from a recognised Board/University. Scientist-H: At least two years' experience as Head of Department in a reputed academic or research institute or industry. At least two years' experience in leading or managing a clinical research centre, medical research centre, clinical trials unit or equivalent programme. Additional qualifications in clinical research, clinical trials, epidemiology, public health or research ethics, including a postgraduate diploma, fellowship or PhD in a relevant discipline. Substantial experience in clinical-trial design, conduct and oversight, research ethics, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), participant protection and quality assurance. Experience in managing multidisciplinary and multi-site research initiatives with academic, healthcare and industry partners. Experience in establishing operational frameworks for clinical research, including protocol development, governance and regulatory compliance. Scientist-G: Individuals with multidisciplinary expertise and a demonstrated leadership background will be preferred. Additional qualifications or training in translational research, drug or biologics development, diagnostics development, regulatory affairs, technology transfer, intellectual property or commercialisation. Demonstrated experience in translating research innovations into products, technologies or solutions, particularly in drugs and therapeutics, biologics or diagnostics. Experience in product development and scale-up, process development, technology validation, regulatory strategy, quality systems, licensing or industry partnerships. Ability to innovate business models for collaborations; prior experience running an incubation centre, centre of excellence or a business unit within an industry is desirable. Scientist-F and Scientist-E (same text for both posts): Expertise or substantial research experience in one or more areas: Animal Facility Management, Antibody Discovery, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Bio-design and Diagnostics, Clinical Pharmacology, Computational Biology/Bioinformatics, Drug Discovery Chemistry, Immunology, Medicinal Chemistry, Microbial Biotherapeutics, Microbiology, Microbiome Research, Synthetic Biology and Viral Vaccine Technologies. Experience in establishing, developing or managing advanced research facilities, technology platforms or specialised laboratories. Experience in developing and applying advanced scientific methodologies, experimental models and computational tools for novel biomedical products, therapeutics or diagnostics. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected incumbent is entitled, in addition to usual pay and allowances, to benefits such as semi-furnished on-campus housing (in lieu of HRA), medical reimbursement, telephone expenses reimbursement, newspaper allowance, Children Education Allowance, Leave Travel Concession, New Pension Scheme (NPS) contribution, Transport Allowance and support for national and international conferences, as per Government of India/BRIC-THSTI rules. A research start-up grant of up to Rs. 1.0 crore may be provided for setting up a new laboratory or facility in the initial years after appointment. The incumbent will mentor other scientists, postdoctoral fellows and PhD students. The incumbent will be encouraged to generate extramural funding from Government and non-government agencies. The incumbent will be permitted to undertake consultancy services on behalf of the institute and retain a portion of the consultancy fees as per the institute's Bye-laws. All positions have a mandatory two-year probationary period upon initial appointment through Direct Recruitment. For selection through Deputation, terms and conditions are governed by DoPT OM No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: BRIC-THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide overall clinical, scientific and operational leadership for all activities of the MRC, setting priorities and coordinating its programmes, teams, infrastructure and external partnerships. Plan and oversee the establishment and functioning of MRC facilities and services, developing collaborative arrangements with industry and other partners, including clinical research, clinical pharmacology, early-phase studies and controlled human infection studies, as applicable. Lead and oversee observational and follow-up studies, cohorts and clinical trials; ensure governance, ethics and regulatory compliance, Good Clinical Practice, participant safety, data integrity and quality systems. Build multidisciplinary and multi-site research programmes and collaborations with academic, clinical, government and industry partners to evaluate vaccines, therapeutics, diagnostics and other health interventions. Provide overall strategic, scientific and operational leadership for APEX, including planning, establishing, operationalising and running its integrated pre-product-development facilities and programmes. Develop and implement collaborative models with industry and other partners for setting up, equipping and operating APEX facilities. Lead and oversee translation of research leads into validated processes, prototypes and product candidates, coordinating programmes in monoclonal antibodies, live biotherapeutics, vaccines, therapeutics, mRNA, genomic and molecular diagnostic kits, IVD manufacturing support and bioassays. Guide developability assessment, process and cell-line development, upstream and downstream processing, analytical characterisation, scale-up and pilot production; ensure quality, biosafety, regulatory and manufacturing readiness. Be responsible for ensuring APEX operates as a financially sustainable and operationally efficient unit, meeting product development deliverables and objectives. In a pandemic or other public-health emergency, lead the conversion of the entire APEX into a national facility for pandemic preparedness and response, working with BRIC/DBT and relevant national agencies. Develop and pursue an independent, high-quality research programme aligned with BRIC-THSTI's translational health research mandate and the needs of the assigned centre or facility. Design and conduct collaborative, multidisciplinary research and contribute to the development, validation or translation of discoveries, methods, technologies or products relevant to health. Publish research findings high impact peer reviewed society journals, pursue intellectual property and extramural funding where appropriate, and build collaborations with national and international research, clinical and industry partners. Mentor research staff, post-doctoral fellows and PhD students, and contribute to the development and use of BRIC-THSTI's research facilities and training programmes. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The posts are filled through Direct Recruitment in the first instance. Deputation/Absorption applicants are considered only if no suitable candidate is empanelled through Direct Recruitment. The notice mentions a written test/skill test/interview and does not give their dates or marks. If many applications are received, screening limits the candidates to those with higher/relevant qualifications, concept notes and experience. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the written test/skill test/interview. Meeting the essential qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be called. Applicants will be asked to explain and defend their concept note during the selection process. Future communications about selection are made only by email. Results and notifications are published only on the BRIC-THSTI website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BRIC-THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 regular scientist positions: Scientist-H (1), Scientist-G (1), Scientist-F (2) and Scientist-E (6).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BRIC-THSTI Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The closing date for the online application is 17 January 2027. Applicants under deputation/absorption mode must send the hard copy by 25 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Scientist-H?
faq.answer: Scientist-H requires an MD in any speciality from a recognised University or Institute, plus a minimum of 12 years' post-qualification experience in a responsible higher position in a Research Institute/University/Industry.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Scientist-G, F and E?
faq.answer: A PhD in Life Sciences or related disciplines, or a PhD in Engineering/Technology such as Chemical/Biomedical/Pharmaceutical Engineering, or an MD/MDS/MVSc. Experience required is 10 years for Scientist-G, 8 years for Scientist-F and 5 years for Scientist-E.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for direct recruitment?
faq.answer: The limit is not exceeding 50 years for Scientist-H, G and F, and not exceeding 45 years for Scientist-E, counted as on the closing date of the online application. SC get 5 years, OBC (Non-Creamy layer) 3 years, PwBD 10/13/15 years and ex-servicemen 5 years of relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of BRIC-THSTI Scientist posts?
faq.answer: Monthly emoluments at present rates are ₹3,99,092 for Scientist-H (Level 15), ₹3,17,080 for Scientist-G (Level 14), ₹2,88,808 for Scientist-F (Level 13A) and ₹2,71,542 for Scientist-E (Level 13).

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Unreserved and OBC candidates pay Rs. 1500/- for Level 13A and below, and Rs. 2000/- for Level 14 and 15. SC/ST/Women/Ex-SM/PwBD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for BRIC-THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://thsti.res.in/en/Jobs through details of applicant, document upload and fee payment. Other modes of application are not accepted.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a written test or interview?
faq.answer: The notice mentions a written test/skill test/interview for shortlisted candidates only, with screening if many applications are received. Applicants will also be asked to defend their concept note.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply under both Direct Recruitment and Deputation?
faq.answer: Yes, if eligible under both modes and wishing to be considered under both, submit a separate application for each mode. Deputation applicants are considered only if no suitable candidate is empanelled through Direct Recruitment.
